name: Do sound insulating windows require special maintenance?

mainEntity.name: Do sound insulating windows require special maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, sound insulating windows do not require significantly different maintenance than standard windows. Regular cleaning of the glass panes and frames with mild soap and water is recommended. It's also advisable to periodically check the seals and weatherstripping for any signs of wear or damage, as compromised seals can reduce both sound and thermal performance. Keep the tracks free of debris to ensure smooth operation. Most modern sound insulating windows are designed for durability and low maintenance, similar to other high-quality window products.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sound insulating windows require regular cleaning of glass and frames. Periodically check seals and tracks for wear or debris to maintain optimal performance.
